name: produce a python script at the required path that solves and writes the answer
definition: author a python program in the specified file that computes the answer without failing to import/run and writes a plain number to the results file, then exits 0.
failure_mode: a runtime error or missing output file fails the run/existence assertion

name: rank urls by frequency and list a top-k with counts
definition: aggregate request counts per URL and write the top-k entries with counts in a specific indented layout and order.
failure_mode: a tie resolved differently or wrong ordering/count fails the comparison

name: rebuild the flink distribution with maven preserving unrelated behavior
definition: Compile and package the runtime/distribution modules so the fix is present in the shipped jars while REST API responses and normal uploads stay unchanged.
failure_mode: Build failure or skipped rebuild leaves an unpatched jar; changing response behavior breaks normal upload checks.

name: record a rerunnable jq command and an args spec
definition: Persist the exact jq command file and a filter-plus-args metadata file that reproduce an identical report when recombined and re-executed.
failure_mode: an args file whose items aren't dash-form, or a drifted command, breaks regeneration
